idleA.motionSemantics: standing crow: folded wings, planted talons, quiet breathing and alert head scan

walkA.motionSemantics: alternating grounded crow walk; folded wings, head stabilization and lateral weight transfer

attack.motionSemantics: authored airborne crow peck: quick neck-only angular jab over continuous flight, adapted because the native Crow has no named Attack

fly.motionSemantics: synchronous crow power stroke; delayed elbow/wrist fold on recovery, stable head and tucked talons

glide.motionSemantics: broad crow wings held open with small symmetric trim

run.motionSemantics: authored faster alternating ground gait adapted from Crow Walk/WalkSpeed; no separate native Run action

hop.motionSemantics: paired-foot hop adapted from Crow Jump; crouch and landing contacts with a outward spread-wing assist during suspension
